about.title: About
about.bio: I'm Carlos, a software engineer based in Mérida, Mexico. I build web platforms, desktop tools and AI features, from a commercial suite of Revit add-ins for construction teams to an investment tracker with a multi-model AI analyst. I studied physics and mathematics, and it shows in the work I enjoy most: geometry, financial math and models that have to be right. I build with coding agents like Claude Code as part of my daily workflow, and I work remotely with teams anywhere.
